claims.claim: Residual loss plus review benefit equals baseline loss.
Moving review time delta from stream 2 to stream 1 changes benefit by delta times the rate difference.
The exchange preserves total reviewer time.
Under ordered rates and nonnegative transfer, the exchange cannot reduce review benefit or increase residual loss.
For fixed total review time, allocation to the higher-rate stream dominates any split in the unconstrained two-stream ledger.
When rates are equal, every allocation with the same total review time has equal benefit.
The exact positive witness and wrong-priority negative control hold.
The exact-rational package regression passes 440080 checks.
Known stationary linear benefit rates, divisible work, additive effects, compatible units, and fungible reviewer time are supplied assumptions.
Calibrated risk, reviewer superiority, subgroup fairness, queueing behavior, field benefit, safe deployment, adoption, delivery, or revenue is established.
